notes.title: Pluralys at Montreal Comiccon + New Gameplay Video!
notes.content:
Pluralys at Montreal Comiccon


🎉 Pluralys will be playable at Montreal Comiccon, from July 4 to 6, 2025!
Come find us in the Loto-Québec Indie Zone to try out our story-driven RPG.

🕹️ You’ll be able to play the demo, meet the dev team. 

Nicolas will do a live Twitch interview on Sunday! [dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/lotoquebec"][/dynamiclink]


New Gameplay Video — Side Quest & Features
In the meantime, we’re sharing a new gameplay video featuring a side quest and some key gameplay mechanics: dialogue choices, exploration, and interactions... Dive into Elie’s world and uncover its secrets.
[previewyoutube="crKViV8JSno;full"][/previewyoutube]
Thanks for all your support and feedback!

notes.title: Try Pluralys during Steam Fest and New Trailer
notes.content:
The Pluralys demo is now available!

It’s official: our demo is live and free to play during the Steam Next Fest 🥳

Dive into the opening chapters of our 2D narrative RPG filled with humor, mystery, and meaningful choices.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/e86d27f4fc7fe8964bba4cca0d35dadff1b4478e.jpg"]
Our trailer is out!

Want to get a taste first? Our first official trailer is now up on YouTube!

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UgMEzQO_Hn0"][/dynamiclink]
Join the Discord!


If you've played Pluralys, don't hesitate to join us on Discord to chat directly with us.


https://discord.com/invite/D2Qq2ZgJzg


Thank you so much for your support. If you enjoy the game, consider leaving a review or sharing it — it really helps 💛

See you soon!

notes.title: Supporting Leucan, Expanding to Spanish & Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Proud to support Leucan!

We’re happy to share that Studios Ivalys is now officially a Leucan Defender (association for children with cancer) — a cause that’s close to our hearts. Every small gesture matters, and we’re honored to contribute in our own way. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/c61d97d56eefab099082121fc457fead8eade620.jpg

 Spanish version in the works!

We're currently working on a Spanish version of Pluralys, so even more players can experience its strange and heartfelt world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/135ce2ad045e1ce8848a5a3e375e09f8a0568556.png

Steam Next Fest is almost here!

We wanted to let you know that the demo is now live on Steam and will be available until June 16 as part of the Steam Next Fest (June 9–16).

It’s the perfect time to dive into the strange and funny world of Pluralys — our cozy 2D narrative RPG all about exploration, humor, and unexpected encounters.

Wishlisting the game already helps us a lot, but if you’d like to support us even further, feel free to leave a review on the demo — it would mean the world to us!

Thanks you so much!

notes.title: Demo Available for Steam Next Fest + Ukrainian Version in the Works!
notes.content:
We're taking part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

We’ve got some exciting news to share: we’re participating in the Steam Next Fest!
A fully playable demo will be available for free — no sign-up or selection required — throughout the entire event.

You’ll be able to access it directly from our game’s main Steam page.
Don’t miss this opportunity to dive into the world of Pluralys!

As a reminder, the next Steam Next Fest will take place from June 9 to June 16.

To make sure you don’t miss anything, add the game to your wishlist and get notified as soon as the demo goes live.


In the meantime, check out our teaser !


[previewyoutube=nCtmHozC-oI;full][/previewyoutube]

We also have another great announcement to share!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/5f16700ec6ecdd69fe076bf41e9f85306cfab50d.png

We’re happy to announce that the Ukrainian translation is currently in progress!
We want to make the game accessible to as many players as possible, and this new language will be added soon.

Feel free to reach out if you’d like to see Pluralys translated into other languages in the future!

If you'd like to chat with us or follow the project more closely, come join our Discord community!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484282/91375d3fe0299818a67afc401927c8620f83e490.png
